points.title: 童年与少年时期
points.description: 福楼拜出生于法国诺曼底地区的鲁昂，父亲是当地著名的外科医生。他在鲁昂度过了童年和青少年时期，接受了良好的古典教育。这段时期，他展现出对文学的浓厚兴趣，尤其是对浪漫主义作家的作品情有独钟。1839年，福楼拜前往巴黎学习法律，但很快放弃了法律专业，全身心投入到文学创作中。在鲁昂的岁月为他后来的创作提供了丰富的素材，尤其是对 provincial life（外省生活）的深刻观察，这成为他日后作品的重要主题。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Rouen, Normandy, to a prominent surgeon father, Flaubert spent his childhood and adolescence in this provincial city. He received a classical education and developed a strong interest in literature, particularly the works of Romantic writers. In 1839, he moved to Paris to study law but quickly abandoned it to pursue literature. His formative years in Rouen provided him with rich material for his later works, especially his profound observations of provincial life, which became a central theme in his writing.

points.title: 文学探索与《包法利夫人》
points.description: 1840年，福楼拜来到巴黎，开始了他作为文学家的生涯。在巴黎，他结识了作家路易·布耶和马克西姆·杜康，三人形成了著名的'三人组'，共同探讨文学创作。1845年，福楼拜经历了第一次精神危机，这促使他更加专注于文学创作。1850-1856年间，他创作了代表作《包法利夫人》，这部作品以其精湛的心理描写和对社会现实的批判而闻名。1857年，《包法利夫人》出版后因'伤风败俗'被起诉，福楼拜最终被判无罪，这一事件确立了他在法国文学界的地位。巴黎时期是福楼拜文学风格形成的关键阶段，他发展出了独特的客观叙事手法。
points.descriptionEn: Moving to Paris in 1840, Flaubert began his career as a writer. There he met writers Louis Bouilhet and Maxime Du Camp, forming the famous 'Trois' trio to discuss literary creation. In 1845, Flaubert experienced his first mental crisis, leading him to focus more intensely on literature. Between 1850-1856, he wrote his masterpiece 'Madame Bovary', renowned for its psychological depth and social critique. When published in 1857, it was prosecuted for 'immorality', but Flaubert was ultimately acquitted, establishing his position in French literature. This Parisian period was crucial for the formation of his literary style, developing his distinctive objective narrative technique.

points.title: 隐居创作
points.description: 1856年后，福楼拜选择回到家乡附近的克罗瓦塞隐居，过着近乎僧侣般的生活。他在塞纳河畔的这座小屋中度过了余生的大部分时间，每天严格按照作息时间进行写作和研究。这种隐居生活使他能够全身心投入创作，但也加剧了他的孤独感。在此期间，他创作了《萨朗波》(1862)、《情感教育》(1869)等重要作品。福楼拜以其对细节的极致追求和对语言的精心雕琢而闻名，据说他常常为寻找一个恰当的词语而花费数小时。克罗瓦塞时期是福楼拜创作的高峰期，他的作品风格更加成熟，对社会现实的批判也更加深刻。
points.descriptionEn: After 1856, Flaubert chose to live in seclusion at Croisset, near his hometown, leading a nearly monastic life. He spent most of his remaining years in this small house by the Seine River, adhering strictly to a daily routine of writing and research. This secluded lifestyle allowed him to devote himself completely to his craft but also intensified his feelings of loneliness. During this period, he created important works such as 'Salammbo' (1862) and 'Sentimental Education' (1869). Flaubert became known for his meticulous attention to detail and careful craftsmanship of language, reportedly spending hours searching for the perfect word. The Croisset period represented the peak of Flaubert's creativity, with his mature style and deeper critique of social reality.

points.title: 普法战争经历
points.description: 1870年普法战争爆发后，福楼拜被征召入伍，担任国民自卫军士兵。这段战争经历对他产生了深远影响，他亲眼目睹了战争的残酷和巴黎公社的动荡。战争期间，他担任卫生员工作，照顾伤员。这段经历使他更加关注社会现实和人类命运，也为他后来的创作提供了素材。战争结束后，福楼拜回到克罗瓦塞，但这段经历改变了他对社会的看法，使他的作品更加关注历史和社会变革。普法战争期间，他与作家乔治·桑等人保持通信，讨论战争对法国社会的影响。
points.descriptionEn: With the outbreak of the Franco-Prussian War in 1870, Flaubert was drafted as a soldier in the National Guard. This wartime experience had a profound impact on him, as he witnessed the brutality of war and the turmoil of the Paris Commune. During the conflict, he worked as a medical orderly, caring for wounded soldiers. This experience deepened his focus on social reality and human destiny, providing material for his later works. After the war, Flaubert returned to Croisset, but this period changed his perspective on society, making his works more concerned with history and social change. During the war, he corresponded with writers like George Sand, discussing the war's impact on French society.

points.title: 晚年创作与影响
points.description: 1873年后，福楼拜进入晚年创作阶段，虽然健康状况逐渐恶化，但他仍然坚持写作。这一时期，他完成了《布瓦尔和佩库歇》(未完成)等作品，并开始整理出版他的书信集。福楼拜对年轻一代作家产生了深远影响，包括莫泊桑、左拉等自然主义作家。他提出了'客观叙事'的文学理念，强调作家应像上帝一样，既不评判也不介入故事，而是客观呈现。1880年5月8日，福楼拜因脑溢血在克罗瓦塞去世，享年58岁。他的去世标志着法国文学一个重要时代的结束，但他的文学理念和创作风格对后世产生了持久影响，被认为是现代小说的重要先驱之一。
points.descriptionEn: After 1873, Flaubert entered his late creative period. Although his health gradually deteriorated, he continued to write. During this time, he completed 'Bouvard and Pécuchet' (unfinished) and began publishing his correspondence collections. Flaubert had a profound influence on younger writers, including naturalists like Maupassant and Zola. He proposed the literary concept of 'objective narrative', emphasizing that writers should be like God—neither judging nor intervening in the story, but presenting it objectively. On May 8, 1880, Flaubert died of a cerebral hemorrhage in Croisset at the age of 58. His death marked the end of an important era in French literature, but his literary concepts and style had a lasting influence, establishing him as one of the important precursors of the modern novel.

appraisal.zh: 福楼拜被视为现代小说的奠基人之一，他以客观叙事突破传统小说的局限，对语言极致追求、对细节精准把握，使《包法利夫人》等作品既批判社会现实又深察人性，其"为艺术而艺术"的主张使他成为唯美主义的重要代表。也有研究者指出，他过分重形式而轻内容，客观叙事有时显得冷漠，细节铺陈使节奏缓慢，对中产阶级的批判不免偏执片面；他与路易丝·科莱的长期关系也被视为道德矛盾。在当代，他被看作追求完美的文学偶像。
appraisal.en: Flaubert is regarded as a founder of the modern novel: his objective narration broke the limits of traditional fiction, and his meticulous pursuit of language and detail give works such as Madame Bovary both social critique and deep insight into human nature, while his 'art for art's sake' stance makes him a key figure of Aestheticism. Yet some researchers note that he stressed form over content, that his detachment can seem cold, that his detail slows the pace, and that his critique of bourgeois life is obsessive and one-sided; his long relationship with Louise Colet is also seen as a moral contradiction. Today he stands as an icon of perfectionism.

supporter.zh: 福楼拜被视为现代小说的奠基人之一，他的文学创新和对心理描写的深刻探索影响了后世无数作家。他通过客观叙事手法，打破了传统小说的局限，开创了现代小说的先河。福楼拜对语言的极致追求和对细节的精准把握，使他的作品具有永恒的艺术价值。他的《包法利夫人》等作品不仅是对社会现实的批判，更是对人性的深刻洞察，展现了作家超越时代的洞察力和艺术成就。
supporter.en: Flaubert is regarded as one of the founders of the modern novel, with his literary innovations and profound exploration of psychological influencing countless writers. Through his objective narrative technique, he broke the limitations of traditional novels, pioneering the way for modern fiction. Flaubert's meticulous pursuit of language and precise attention to detail give his works eternal artistic value. His works like 'Madame Bovary' not only critique social reality but also offer profound insights into human nature, demonstrating the writer's transcendent vision and artistic achievement.

critic.zh: 批评者认为福楼拜的作品过于注重形式而忽视了内容，他的客观叙事有时显得冷漠无情。他对细节的过度追求使作品节奏缓慢，难以吸引普通读者。此外，福楼拜对中产阶级生活的批判虽然深刻，但有时显得偏执和片面，缺乏对更广泛社会问题的关注。他的个人生活也受到批评，尤其是与路易丝·科莱的长期关系，被认为反映了某种道德矛盾。
critic.en: Critics argue that Flaubert's works place excessive emphasis on form at the expense of content, and his objective narrative sometimes appears cold and detached. His excessive attention to detail makes the pacing slow, making it difficult to engage general readers. Furthermore, while his critique of middle-class life is profound, it can seem obsessive and one-sided, lacking attention to broader social issues. His personal life has also been criticized, particularly his long relationship with Louise Colet, which is seen as reflecting certain moral contradictions.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，福楼拜被定义为文学现代性的重要象征。他的创作理念和技巧影响了自然主义、现代主义等多种文学流派。福楼拜'为艺术而艺术'的主张，使他成为唯美主义的重要代表。他的名言'包法利夫人，那就是我'揭示了作家与人物之间的复杂关系，成为文学批评的经典引用。在当代文化中，福楼拜被视为追求完美主义的文学偶像，他的生活和工作方式影响了无数创作者，同时也成为艺术与生活关系的探讨对象。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Flaubert is defined as an important symbol of literary modernity. His creative concepts and techniques influenced various literary movements including Naturalism and Modernism. Flaubert's advocacy of 'art for art's sake' makes him a key representative of Aestheticism. His famous quote 'Madame Bovary, that's me' reveals the complex relationship between writer and character, becoming a classic reference in literary criticism. In contemporary culture, Flaubert is seen as a literary icon who pursued perfectionism; his lifestyle and work ethic have influenced countless creators while also becoming a subject of exploration regarding the relationship between art and life.
